post.title: Why You Think It Won't Happen to You #shorts
post.description: Are you the 'I'll be fine' type? Tell me in the comments. Send this to the friend who never reads the parking sign. Rosa parks on the yellow line: 'I won't get a ticket.' In 'Unrealistic Optimism About Future Life Events' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1980), Neil Weinstein asked college students to rate their own chances of dozens of future events compared with their classmates'. On average they rated themselves more likely than their peers to have good things happen and less likely to have bad things happen. Not everyone can be above average, so as a group they were too optimistic. It's called optimism bias, and it's extremely common. Hope isn't the problem; skipping the sign is. #psychology #shorts #optimismbias #overthinking #mindset
